<translate>
<!--T:5-->
'''Babidi's Spaceship''' (Babidi's Ship) is the wizard [[Special:MyLanguage/Babidi|Babidi]]'s ship in the mountains of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]], reaching underground. Evil-aligned players come here to receive the Majin mark.
</translate>

<translate>
== Who lives here == <!--T:6-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:7-->
'''[[Special:MyLanguage/Babidi|Babidi]]''' offers '''Receive the Mark''': he gives you the '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Majin Mark|Majin mark]]''', a permanent power boost, if your alignment is below 39. He teaches no skills.
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding it == <!--T:8-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:9-->
The ship generates once per world, in the mountains. Because it reaches underground, it keeps its own placement instead of being fitted to the terrain like other houses. [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Assistant|Capsule Corp Assistants]] can sell a '''Babidi's Spaceship Map''' at trade tier 5, for 4 Ender Pearls and an empty Map. Players with the locate permission can use {{Command|/dmzlocate babidi}}. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Finding structures|Finding structures]].
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:10-->
Like every master's home, the ship can't be damaged by ki attacks (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Protection|Protection]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:11-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:12-->
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] quest 10, ''Find Babidi's Ship'': find Babidi's Spaceship.
* Buu Saga quest 11, ''Babidi's Guard: Pui Pui'': defeat [[Special:MyLanguage/Pui Pui|Pui Pui]] at Babidi's Spaceship.
* Buu Saga quest 12, ''Babidi's Guard: Yakon'': defeat [[Special:MyLanguage/Yakon|Yakon]] at Babidi's Spaceship.
* Buu Saga quest 13, ''Dabura, King of Demons'': defeat [[Special:MyLanguage/Dabura|Dabura]] at Babidi's Spaceship.
* Buu Saga quest 14, ''Majin Buu Awakens'': defeat [[Special:MyLanguage/Majin Buu|Majin Buu]] at Babidi's Spaceship.
* The side quest ''Babidi's Ship'', available after Buu Saga quest 17, sends you back to the ship to defeat Pui Pui again (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Sidequests|Sidequests]]).
</translate>
